newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil futures end $1.50 down.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil futures end $1.50 down.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures closed near session lows on Thursday, ending $1.50 down following steady selling of the Jan-Feb spread, traders said.
IPE gas oil last traded at $217.75, down $4.5 from the highs and 75 cents off the low.
"There was some pretty steady selling of the Jan-Feb spread throughout the afternoon," a broker said. "It was also a fairly choppy afternoon in the States and that put pressure on London."
"There has really been little news to affect the market. There was a lot of cold weather talk earlier in the week that affected the market and that spilled over into heating oil."
Physical demand was sketchy and the crack spread weak, traders said.

February Brent crude oil futures were $23.85 a barrel at 1747 GMT. This was seven cents under Wednesday's settlement and a recovery from early losses on short-covering on the NYMEX ahead of the January crude contract expiry.
Brent earlier touched a low of $23.67 per barrel.
